zh-CN.title: 《庄子》文本形成视野
zh-CN.shortSummary: 战国至早期帝国之间的篇章、传述和编纂形成了《庄子》的复合文本传统。
curatorialDescription: 事件表示文本层的形成区间，不等同于庄周在某年完成全书。
zh-CN.researchNote: 篇章层和注疏节点需继续按版本拆分。

en.title: The textual horizon of the Zhuangzi
en.shortSummary: Chapter, transmission and compilation layers across the Warring States and early imperial periods shaped the composite Zhuangzi tradition.
curatorialDescription: The event marks a formation range rather than claiming that Zhuang Zhou completed the whole work in one year.
en.researchNote: Chapter layers and commentaries require version-level separation.

zh-CN.title: 孟子游说诸侯与讲学传统
zh-CN.shortSummary: 孟子游历诸侯、论政和讲学的传述成为儒家政治伦理的重要人物—事件入口。
curatorialDescription: 本事件保留游历与言说的传统层，不绘制未经证实的逐站路线。
zh-CN.researchNote: 各国行迹、会见对象和文本记录需逐条拆分。

en.title: Mencius's itinerant counsel and teaching
en.shortSummary: Accounts of Mencius travelling among rulers, offering counsel and teaching became a major figure–event entry for Confucian political ethics.
curatorialDescription: The event keeps itinerary and speech in a traditional layer and does not draw an unverified stop-by-stop route.
en.researchNote: States visited, interlocutors and textual records require separate entries.

zh-CN.title: 天师道传统的形成与组织化
zh-CN.shortSummary: 张道陵及其后继谱系被放入东汉至六朝的组织、授受与神圣化形成层。
curatorialDescription: 事件连接人物、文本和鹤鸣山传统空间，但不把后世谱系全部写回东汉现场。
zh-CN.researchNote: 教团组织、经箓文本和祖师谱系需要分别核对。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 传统置于东汉；约 142 的传述节点

en.title: Formation and organisation of the Celestial Masters tradition
en.shortSummary: Zhang Daoling and successor lineages are placed within Eastern Han to Six Dynasties layers of organisation, transmission and sacralisation.
curatorialDescription: The event connects figure, text and Heming Mountain traditions without projecting the entire later lineage into an Eastern Han scene.
en.researchNote: Organisation, registers and founder genealogies require separate verification.
en.timeLabel: Traditionally placed in the Eastern Han; a transmitted c. 142 node

displayDate.zh-CN: 传统置于东汉；约 142 的传述节点
displayDate.en: Traditionally placed in the Eastern Han; a transmitted c. 142 node

zh-CN.title: 葛洪《抱朴子》文本活动
zh-CN.shortSummary: 东晋时期的《抱朴子》写作与知识整理连接道教、炼养、伦理和政治论述。
curatorialDescription: 事件突出文本工程和知识网络，不把后世神仙叙事当作同一层的实验记录。
zh-CN.researchNote: 内外篇、版本和地域活动需继续细化。

en.title: Ge Hong's Baopuzi textual activity
en.shortSummary: Eastern Jin writing and knowledge organisation in the Baopuzi connect Daoist cultivation, ethics, politics and technical discourse.
curatorialDescription: The event foregrounds textual work and knowledge networks rather than treating later immortality narratives as laboratory records.
en.researchNote: Inner/outer chapters, versions and regional activity require refinement.

zh-CN.title: 阿育王敕诏与法政策
zh-CN.shortSummary: 阿育王时期的敕诏把治理、伦理政策、铭刻和跨区域传播放在同一历史事件框架中。
curatorialDescription: 敕诏与后世佛教传记分开呈现；桑奇是现实遗址锚点，不代表阿育王全部活动范围。
zh-CN.researchNote: 敕诏分类、遗址序列和佛教网络需进一步细分。

en.title: Ashoka's edicts and dhamma policy
en.shortSummary: Ashokan edicts place governance, ethical policy, inscriptions and transregional circulation in one historical event frame.
curatorialDescription: Edicts and later Buddhist biography remain separate; Sanchi is a real-site anchor, not the full extent of Ashoka's activity.
en.researchNote: Edict groups, site sequence and Buddhist networks require further separation.

zh-CN.title: 龙树与中观论辩的形成视野
zh-CN.shortSummary: 约公元 2–3 世纪的中观论辩构成龙树及其后世解释传统的思想事件入口。
curatorialDescription: 人物年代、文本归属和后世中观影响分开建模，不把学派发展倒写为单一生平事实。
zh-CN.researchNote: 作品归属、地区和汉译链需继续核对。

en.title: The Madhyamaka horizon associated with Nāgārjuna
en.shortSummary: Second- to third-century Madhyamaka debate provides an event entry into Nāgārjuna and later interpretive traditions.
curatorialDescription: Figure dating, textual attribution and later Madhyamaka influence remain separate rather than turning school development into one biography.
en.researchNote: Work attribution, regional setting and Chinese transmission require review.

zh-CN.title: 鸠摩罗什长安译经活动
zh-CN.shortSummary: 约 401–413 年的长安译经活动把龟兹、后秦都城、译场和汉译佛典连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 译者、译场、参与者与单部经典保持不同节点；不把团队成果归于单一译者。
zh-CN.researchNote: 具体译本、译场人员和版本流传需接入目录级来源。

en.title: Kumarajiva's translation activity in Chang'an
en.shortSummary: Translation activity around 401–413 connected Kucha, the Later Qin capital, translation institutions and Chinese Buddhist texts.
curatorialDescription: Translator, translation bureau, collaborators and individual scriptures remain separate; team production is not assigned to one translator alone.
en.researchNote: Specific translations, personnel and version transmission require catalogue-level sources.

zh-CN.title: 法显求法与《佛国记》记录
zh-CN.shortSummary: 约 399–414 年的求法旅行和归国记录把长安、南亚学习网络与汉文旅行文本连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 路线节点保留现实地理与区域尺度，不把重建路线当作逐日事实。
zh-CN.researchNote: 出发、停留和归返节点需继续按文本段落定位。

en.title: Faxian's pilgrimage and the Foguoji record
en.shortSummary: The pilgrimage and post-return record around 399–414 connects Chang'an, South Asian learning networks and a Chinese travel text.
curatorialDescription: Waypoints retain real geography and regional scale without presenting a reconstructed route as a day-by-day fact.
en.researchNote: Departure, stops and return nodes require passage-level localisation.

zh-CN.title: 盘古开辟天地
zh-CN.shortSummary: 盘古开辟叙事是中国宇宙生成神话的象征性事件，不进入现实历史年代或地理地图。
curatorialDescription: 事件进入神话时间与象征空间，用来展示宇宙秩序如何被叙述。
zh-CN.researchNote: 不同文本中的盘古版本、成书时代和后世图像需分开记录。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 神话时间：无单一历史纪年

en.title: Pangu separates heaven and earth
en.shortSummary: Pangu's creation narrative is a symbolic cosmogenic event, not an entry on a real historical timeline or geographic map.
curatorialDescription: The event belongs to mythic time and symbolic space, showing how cosmic order is narrated.
en.researchNote: Versions, textual dates and later visual memory require separate records.
en.timeLabel: Mythic time: no single historical date

displayDate.zh-CN: 神话时间：无单一历史纪年
displayDate.en: Mythic time: no single historical date

zh-CN.title: 女娲补天与造人
zh-CN.shortSummary: 女娲补天与造人叙事把创生、修复和秩序重建组织为神话事件。
curatorialDescription: 事件不对应现实地图地点；女娲的后世祭祀和艺术记忆另建接受层。
zh-CN.researchNote: 女娲版本、文本见证和地域信仰需继续拆分。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 神话时间：无单一历史纪年

en.title: Nuwa creates humans and repairs the sky
en.shortSummary: Nuwa's creation and sky-repair narratives organise generation, repair and restored order as a mythic event.
curatorialDescription: The event has no real geographic coordinate; later cult and visual memory belong to reception layers.
en.researchNote: Versions, textual witnesses and regional traditions require separation.
en.timeLabel: Mythic time: no single historical date

displayDate.zh-CN: 神话时间：无单一历史纪年
displayDate.en: Mythic time: no single historical date

zh-CN.title: 伏羲画卦与秩序生成
zh-CN.shortSummary: 伏羲画卦叙事把符号、分类与宇宙秩序连接起来。
curatorialDescription: 卦象是象征和思想史的入口，不把传说人物当作可考的制度发明者。
zh-CN.researchNote: 伏羲谱系、卦象传统与后世图像需分开标注。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 神话时间：无单一历史纪年

en.title: Fu Xi draws the trigrams and orders the world
en.shortSummary: Fu Xi's trigram narrative links symbols, classification and cosmic order.
curatorialDescription: The trigrams are an entry into symbolic and intellectual history, not evidence of a historically verified inventor.
en.researchNote: Fu Xi genealogies, trigram traditions and later visual memory require separate labels.
en.timeLabel: Mythic time: no single historical date

displayDate.zh-CN: 神话时间：无单一历史纪年
displayDate.en: Mythic time: no single historical date

zh-CN.title: 黄帝传说中的秩序与统治
zh-CN.shortSummary: 黄帝叙事把祖先谱系、政治秩序、医术和后世国家象征汇入传说人物层。
curatorialDescription: 黄帝不是被放入可考的公元前纪年，而是在传说与后世政治记忆中定位。
zh-CN.researchNote: 五帝叙事、黄帝术数和国家象征需逐层拆分。

en.title: Legendary sovereignty and order around Huangdi
en.shortSummary: Huangdi narratives gather ancestral genealogy, political order, medicine and later state symbolism around a legendary figure.
curatorialDescription: Huangdi is not assigned a speculative BCE date; the entry locates him in legend and later political memory.
en.researchNote: Five Emperors narratives, technical traditions and state symbolism require separate layers.
en.timeLabel: Legendary time: no verifiable birth date

displayDate.en: Legendary time: no verifiable birth date

zh-CN.title: 西王母与昆仑神圣传统
zh-CN.shortSummary: 西王母与昆仑叙事把仙境、长生、边界和神圣女性形象连接成象征空间。
curatorialDescription: 昆仑在本馆作为神圣象征空间呈现，不与现实山地坐标混淆。
zh-CN.researchNote: 文本、图像与地方祭祀传统需分别建档。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 神话与神圣传统时间：无单一历史纪年

en.title: Xi Wangmu and the Kunlun sacred tradition
en.shortSummary: Xi Wangmu and Kunlun narratives connect immortality, boundaries and a sacred female figure in symbolic space.
curatorialDescription: Kunlun is presented as sacred symbolic space and is not conflated with coordinates for a real mountain range.
en.researchNote: Texts, images and local cult traditions require separate records.
en.timeLabel: Mythic and sacred traditional time: no single historical date

displayDate.zh-CN: 神话与神圣传统时间：无单一历史纪年
displayDate.en: Mythic and sacred traditional time: no single historical date

zh-CN.title: 老子神格化为太上老君
zh-CN.shortSummary: 后世道教把老子纳入神圣谱系，形成太上老君这一独立身份与天界空间。
curatorialDescription: 事件只描述神格化和接受史，不把太上老君的天界身份回写成老子历史生平。
zh-CN.researchNote: 出现年代、经典形成和三清谱系需继续按文本与仪式资料核对。
zh-CN.timeLabel: 约汉末至唐代的后世层（200–700）

en.title: Laozi's sacralisation as Taishang Laojun
en.shortSummary: Later Daoist traditions placed Laozi within a sacred genealogy, forming Taishang Laojun as a distinct identity and celestial space.
curatorialDescription: The event describes sacralisation and reception without writing Taishang Laojun's celestial identity back into Laozi's historical biography.
en.researchNote: Emergence, textual formation and Three Pure Ones genealogy require textual and ritual review.
en.timeLabel: Later layer from late Han to Tang (200–700)

displayDate.zh-CN: 约汉末至唐代的后世层（200–700）
displayDate.en: Later layer from late Han to Tang (200–700)
